countries_thin_or_null: Qatar — e-GDDS confirmed and Planning and Statistics Authority identified, but detailed primary methodology pages naming exact SNA/COICOP edition remain thinner than for Jordan or Lebanon in this pass
Bahrain — e-GDDS implemented only in 2024; institutional node and tier solid, but flagship release methodology statements still limited

proposed_reports.title: GCC Statistical Centre (GCC-Stat)
proposed_reports.description: Official regional statistical centre established to provide a common pool of statistics and data for the six GCC member states and to support harmonisation of methodologies.

proposed_reports.title: Department of Statistics (Jordan)
proposed_reports.description: National statistical office responsible for compiling and disseminating official statistics including national accounts and consumer price indices.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts of Jordan
proposed_reports.description: Annual and quarterly GDP and related national accounts aggregates compiled under SNA 2008.

proposed_reports.title: Central Administration of Statistics (Lebanon)
proposed_reports.publisher: Presidency of the Council of Ministers, Lebanon
proposed_reports.description: National statistical office responsible for official socio-economic statistics, national accounts and CPI.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts of Lebanon
proposed_reports.description: Annual (and on-request quarterly) national accounts estimates compiled on the basis of the System of National Accounts 2008.

proposed_reports.title: Central Statistical Bureau (Kuwait)
proposed_reports.description: National statistical office responsible for official statistics including national accounts and prices.

proposed_reports.title: Planning and Statistics Authority (Qatar)
proposed_reports.description: National statistical authority responsible for official statistics including national accounts and CPI.

proposed_reports.title: National Centre for Statistics and Information (Oman)
proposed_reports.description: National statistical centre responsible for official statistics and host of the e-GDDS National Summary Data Page.

proposed_reports.title: Information & eGovernment Authority (Bahrain) – Statistics
proposed_reports.description: Government authority whose statistics sector produces official macroeconomic and socio-demographic data and contributes to the e-GDDS NSDP.

dependencies.basis: IMF DSBB SDDS metadata for Jordan national accounts explicitly states that DOS statistics are based on the concepts and definitions of the 2008 SNA.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The DOS statistics are in general based on the concepts and definitions recommended by 2008 system National Accounts (SNA 2008).

dependencies.basis: Jordan is an SDDS subscriber; the 2024 Annual Observance Report confirms ongoing observance covering national accounts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Jordan subscribed to the SDDS on January 28, 2010, and met all the SDDS requirements at the time of subscription.

dependencies.basis: DSBB metadata for Jordan national accounts states that the Classification of individual consumption by purpose (COICOP) is used.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Classification of individual consumption by purpose (COICOP) is used.

dependencies.basis: CAS official national accounts page states that the methodology used for the 2024 estimates is based on the System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The methodology used is based on the System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008.

dependencies.basis: Lebanon participates in the IMF e-GDDS; the DSBB summary of dissemination practices lists national accounts under e-GDDS categories.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Lebanon — Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) with National Accounts (GDP) category.

dependencies.basis: Kuwait participates in e-GDDS; the DSBB summary lists national accounts and CPI under e-GDDS dissemination practices, with NSDP hosted by the Central Bank of Kuwait linking CSB data.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Kuwait — Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) participant.

dependencies.basis: Kuwait is a founding member state of the GCC; GCC-Stat is the official regional statistical body for the six GCC members including Kuwait.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Charter was officially endorsed in December 2012 by the GCC Supreme Council (comprised of heads of member states: United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Bahrain, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, State of Qatar and State of Kuwait).

dependencies.basis: Qatar participates in e-GDDS (NSDP launched 2019) as confirmed in IMF regional assessments of GCC data standards.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The remaining five countries currently participate in the Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) with operational National Summary Data Pages launched at different stages: ... Qatar (2019) ...

dependencies.basis: Qatar is a founding member state of the GCC; GCC-Stat is the official regional statistical body for the six GCC members including Qatar.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Charter was officially endorsed in December 2012 by the GCC Supreme Council (comprised of heads of member states: United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Bahrain, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, State of Qatar and State of Kuwait).

dependencies.basis: Oman implemented e-GDDS in 2018; the NSDP is hosted by the National Centre for Statistics and Information.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Oman has launched a National Summary Data Page (NSDP), becoming one of the first Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries to implement the recommendations of the enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS).

dependencies.basis: Oman is a founding member state of the GCC; GCC-Stat is headquartered in Muscat and is the official regional statistical body for the six GCC members including Oman.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Charter was officially endorsed in December 2012 by the GCC Supreme Council (comprised of heads of member states: United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Bahrain, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, State of Qatar and State of Kuwait).

dependencies.basis: Bahrain implemented e-GDDS in 2024 with the launch of its National Summary Data Page; data are provided by the Information and eGovernment Authority among others.
dependencies.evidence_quote: With the successful launch of the new data portal, the National Summary Data Page (NSDP) today, Bahrain has implemented a key recommendation of the IMF’s Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS).

dependencies.basis: Bahrain is a founding member state of the GCC; GCC-Stat is the official regional statistical body for the six GCC members including Bahrain.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Charter was officially endorsed in December 2012 by the GCC Supreme Council (comprised of heads of member states: United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Bahrain, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, State of Qatar and State of Kuwait).
